title: Specialist
description: One temporary specialist a function agent spawned for one task (EE-213), at operations/specialists/<role>.json (route operations/specialist/[id]): its parent function agent, the task, the skills it may load, the write reach it was given and when it expires. The record is the reach: the router gives the role the globs here that its parent's own reach still covers, and nothing else, so a specialist can never be wider than its parent whatever this file says (reachRefusal in packages/naive/src/engine/agents/reach.ts). Once status is not live, or expires has passed, the reach is gone and every write by the role is refused. Written by naive agent spawn as the parent agent, or by a person revoking it; reach is not a decision about the venture, only the agent dividing work it may already do.

id.description: The role id and the file name without .json: <parent function>-specialist-<slug>. It is what MENTURA_ACTOR_ID is set to

parent.description: The function agent that spawned it, <function>-agent. A lead, a researcher and another specialist cannot spawn one

function.description: The parent's function, an id in packages/naive/src/functions/departments.json

task.description: The one task it was spawned for, in the parent's words. Its brief names this and the parent

skills.description: Skills from the parent function's module to load, by name. A skill the parent does not have is refused at the spawn

writes.description: The write globs it was given, each inside one of the parent's (functionWrites). The router intersects them with the parent's reach again on every write

spawned_by.description: The acting role or person that spawned it: the parent agent, or a person

expires.description: When the reach is gone, spawned_at plus the ttl. The default ttl is an unvalidated prior in packages/naive/src/engine/specialists.json, overridden under specialists in naive.config.json

status.description: live: the reach stands until expires. finished: its run ended, so the reach is gone. revoked: a person ended it early

finished_at.description: When its run ended or a person revoked it
